scope: adversarial — fiscal seq allocation race, chain extension skip, refund-without-extend, audit_log tamper attempt
lens: find the kill — attack vectors against five NF525 invariants
attack_attempts_evaluated: A1: Two concurrent POS cashiers allocate same fiscal_sequence_no
A2: Cache::lock fails (Redis outage) — can a writer slip past?
A3: HMAC chain fork — two parallel audit writes with same prev_hash
A4: Skip chain extension — refund without audit_log entry
A5: Tamper audit_logs row via Eloquent update / raw SQL UPDATE
A6: Delete audit_logs / z_reports row via Eloquent delete
A9: Bypass FiscalSequenceService via direct INSERT with manual fiscal_sequence_no
A10: Race PaymentService::payment() from non-gateway caller
A11: Bypass mode (payment.bypass.enabled) skips fiscal sealing
A12: Kiosk allocation fails silently — orphan PAID order excluded from Z forever
A13: Z close runs over an orphan window — silent exclusion break
A14: Post-Z refund creates double-count (mirror + late RETURNED)
A15: HMAC secret rotation: legacy chain breaks after secret change
A16: Verify-chain false-negative on non-existent branch (--branch=999)

defense_chain: L1 Cache::lock('fiscal_seq_b{N}',5s)+block(3s) — serialises cashiers per branch
L2 Order::lockForUpdate()->max('fiscal_sequence_no') inside transaction — row-level DB lock
L3 UNIQUE index orders_branch_fiscal_seq_unique — final rejection at storage layer
A1_concurrent_alloc.kill_required: Defeating all 3 simultaneously is implausible (cache outage + DB lock failure + index drop)

defense_chain: Documented at FiscalSequenceService L77-91 — even with cache lock disabled, lockForUpdate + UNIQUE serialise
If cache.lock blocks throw, the request fails — RuntimeException at L70-73 — no fiscal seq is allocated
Sequence stays gap-free (next caller sees same MAX)
A2_cache_outage.kill_required: Replace UNIQUE constraint at DBA layer — out of scope for any application attacker

defense_chain: Cache::lock('audit_chain_b{N}',10s)+block(5s) — serialises per branch
DB::transaction wraps tail-read + INSERT atomically (same connection)
UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) — DB rejects fork even on cache split-brain
QueryException 23000/23505 detection at L185 triggers exactly-one retry with new tail
A3_chain_fork.kill_required: Two writers, both with stale prev_hash, both retry simultaneously — bounded by retry counter (attempt < 2) — third attempt throws

defense_chain: RefundWithCounterEntryService L194-210 — AuditLogService::write inside SAME DB::transaction as mirror order creation
If audit write fails, mirror order INSERT rolls back (atomicity)
PaymentService::cashBack L123-137 — audit write inside transaction; failure propagates
PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment L231-243 — same pattern
PaymentService::cancelCounterPayment L443-454 — same pattern
A4_refund_without_audit.kill_required: Bypass DB::transaction altogether — would require new caller path not yet auditable

defense_chain: BEFORE UPDATE trigger on audit_logs (MySQL SIGNAL '45000' + SQLite RAISE ABORT) — rejects all UPDATE
Even if trigger somehow disabled: verifyChain() recomputes HMAC and returns first tampered row id
Fiscal-chain-monitor cron at 03:30 daily catches any drift since previous run
A5_tamper_via_update.kill_required: Disable trigger AND avoid daily cron AND match HMAC of tampered payload (requires secret)

defense_chain: BEFORE DELETE trigger on audit_logs + z_reports + cash_movements + cash_drawer_sessions + order_payments — all reject DELETE
FK cascade replaced by restrictOnDelete — parent DELETE fails at FK layer before reaching child rows
Migration down() blocked in APP_ENV=production for audit_logs
A6_delete_audit_row.kill_required: Drop trigger + run DELETE — DBA-level intrusion, not service-layer

defense_chain: MySQL TRUNCATE bypasses triggers by design (documented in 3 migrations)
Mitigation = revoke TRUNCATE permission on production DB user via GRANT
Outside migration scope; standard NF525 deployment posture
A7_truncate_bypass.kill_required: DBA-level compromise of production DB credentials — same as A6

defense_chain: 5 INSERT-only call sites — no UPDATE path exists in service layer
order_items.composition_snapshot is plain JSON column — no DB constraint, BUT no service writes UPDATE on this column
Forging would require direct SQL UPDATE → triggers an audit_log entry for the parent action via OrderService/OrderItem listeners → tamper-evident
Even if forged: KDSOrderItemsResource + OrderItemResource read both composition_snapshot AND legacy item_variations/item_extras — drift would be visible in receipts
A8_forge_composition_snapshot.kill_required: Forge AND match downstream HMAC chain — secret-knowledge required

defense_chain: If attacker INSERTs Order with manual fiscal_sequence_no skipping FiscalSequenceService: UNIQUE constraint blocks duplicates

If attacker INSERTs with a gap (e.g. seq 5 then seq 10): gap-free invariant breaks BUT Z aggregate uses whereNotNull('fiscal_sequence_no') with no gap check — gap would show up in fiscal:verify-chain only via signature mismatch on Z (since aggregate would not include the missing rows)
Defense: audit_logs entry for the order creation would be missing → operator sees suspicious row with no audit trail
Mitigation: row-level access control — manual INSERT requires DB write permission
A9_direct_insert_bypass.kill_required: DB write access + matching HMAC computation

defense_chain: P0-POS-02 GOAL round-2 2026-05-18 — PaymentService::payment now requires backtrace frame from PaymentAbstract subclass
Test escape hatch is one-shot (forgetInstance after consume) — cannot leak across tests/requests
HTTP 403 rejection + structured Log::warning at L607-610
A10_payment_non_gateway_caller.kill_required: Subclass PaymentAbstract from outside vendor namespace — requires code deploy

defense_chain: BypassAuditLogger L15-19 docblock: bypass preserves sealing fiscal + Outbox + audit log + idempotency
Only TPE driver / printer TCP/IP calls are short-circuited
AppServiceProvider boot() abort() in production prevents bypass at runtime
A11_bypass_skips_fiscal.kill_required: Patch BypassAuditLogger AND deploy AND enable bypass in production — multi-stage

defense_chain: FrontendOrderService L1174-1188 — alloc failure persists fiscal_alloc_error_at marker
RetryFiscalAllocCommand cron every minute (withoutOverlapping(5) onOneServer) re-invokes finalize
ZReportService::warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders L586-616 — pre-Z close warns operators about pending orphans in window
Iter14 SPECIALIST-3 / FISCAL-ORPHAN-RETRY hardening complete
A12_kiosk_alloc_silent_orphan.kill_required: Disable cron + suppress warnings + cron-skip — operator-visible

defense_chain: aggregate L340 whereNotNull('fiscal_sequence_no') — orphans excluded from Z totals (NF525 gap-free invariant preserved)
warnOnOrphanedPaidOrders L586-616 — operator gets fiscal log warning + can delay close
Orphan eventually retried by cron + included in NEXT Z window — no permanent loss
A13_z_close_over_orphan.kill_required: Force Z close while suppressing warning channel + ignore retry cron logs

defense_chain: WAVE5-POS-001 — RefundWithCounterEntryService::execute asserts parent is in CLOSED Z window via SealedOrderGuard::assertSealed
Without this guard, a pre-Z order could get a mirror AND a separate cashier could transition to RETURNED via pre-Z path → double-count
Now: pre-Z orders use standard RETURNED path; post-Z orders MUST use counter-entry. Single SSOT predicate.
A14_post_z_double_count.kill_required: Disable feature flag fiscal.sealed_z_guard_enabled in production — operator-visible

defense_chain: FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_{id} env override allows per-branch secret rotation
Each branch has independent chain — rotating one branch's secret invalidates only that branch's verifyChain output going forward
verifyChain uses the CURRENT secret to recompute hashes — historical rows signed with old secret would fail recompute
Documented mitigation in docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md (existence confirmed) — rotation runbook required
A15_secret_rotation_breaks_chain.kill_required: Naive rotation without runbook — process-level, not technical attack
A15_secret_rotation_breaks_chain.operator_caveat: Secret rotation MUST follow docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md runbook — naive .env change would break verifyChain for all historical rows on that branch. This is INHERENT to HMAC chains and not a vulnerability.

defense_chain: Wave 3 P1 FISCAL-ADV3-01 — FiscalVerifyChainCommand L104 Branch::where('id',$id)->exists() check before service call
Non-existent branch returns exit 2 (INVALID) — not exit 0 (false-negative CHAIN OK)
Wave 2d FISCAL-ADV3C-03 — --branch=0 rejected as reserved admin/global sentinel; --all is the real cross-branch sweep
A16_verify_chain_false_negative.kill_required: Trick monitoring to interpret exit 2 as exit 0 — requires monitoring config override

five_invariants_red_verdict.I-1_sequence_monotonic_gap_free: BLOCKED via 3-layer defense (cache + DB lock + UNIQUE)
five_invariants_red_verdict.I-2_hmac_chain_atomic: BLOCKED via cache lock + DB transaction + UNIQUE(branch_id, prev_hash) + retry-once
five_invariants_red_verdict.I-3_composition_snapshot_frozen: BLOCKED at service layer (5 INSERT sites + 1 copy-forward; no UPDATE path exists)
five_invariants_red_verdict.I-4_db_triggers_active: BLOCKED at storage engine — un-bypassable via Eloquent or raw SQL UPDATE/DELETE
five_invariants_red_verdict.I-5_truncate_bypass_mitigation: MITIGATED at deploy layer via GRANT — standard NF525 posture (industry-confirmed)

keep_as_is: All 16 attack vectors blocked or mitigated at appropriate defense layer
Defense-in-depth correctly layered: service (lock) -> transaction (atomicity) -> index (final gate) -> trigger (DB enforcement) -> cron (drift detection)

summary: RED-team unable to breach NF525 invariants without DBA-level credential compromise (A6/A7/A9) or process-level operator override (A11/A12/A14). All 16 application-layer attack vectors blocked at one of: cache lock, DB transaction, UNIQUE index, trigger, cron retry, sealed-order guard, or chain re-walk. Fiscal cascade defense is correctly defense-in-depth. No exploitable weakness identified.
